finite_map: M_RPF_post_stack_stress : (K, event_x, shell stack Sigma_r(x), Omega_r, rho_omega, compatibility weights w_omega, ordered adapter tuple A0..A8, compression C, finite stress family S) -> (rho_present_stress, outward_record_stress, per-stress survivor tuple, stability residuals, N01 order gaps, failed controls, resource blockers, blocked consumers)

domain.K: finite PEPS3D carrier K=(V,E,F,C_cells) with event_x anchored in V union E union F union C_cells
domain.shells: finite shell radii r in {1,2,3} with future_inward shell orientation and past_outward record orientation
domain.Omega_r: finite future/refinement branches and spinor-derived rho_omega branch states
domain.compatibility_weights: finite normalized weights over Omega_r, applied before compression
adapter_tuple: A7 nested Hopf shell projection adapter
finite_stress_family: bond_dim 2 and 4 where row-local receipts support bond 4

codomain_or_output.rho_present_stress: finite trace-one stress survivor readouts preserving M_RPF(C) provenance
codomain_or_output.outward_record_stress: finite past_outward record for each stress row
codomain_or_output.per_stress_survivor_tuple: ordered tuple of survivor/readout summaries for each admitted stress
codomain_or_output.stability_residuals: finite residuals comparing event_x, shell radii, Omega_r, compatibility weights, PEPS3D anchors, and row-local adapter provenance before and after stress
codomain_or_output.N01_order_gaps: finite adapter-order gaps that must survive positive stress and collapse only in order-erased controls
codomain_or_output.failed_controls: negative controls that correctly fail object preservation
codomain_or_output.resource_blockers: explicit blocker fields if bond/site growth cannot be kept finite without dense closure
codomain_or_output.blocked_consumers: downstream consumers kept locked regardless of stress pass

positive_requirements_for_future_scout: M_RPF_stack_0_8 result must validate without fresh rerun unless stale
all stress carriers, paths, adapters, shells, and outputs remain finite
Omega_r compatibility weights precede every compression readout
rho_present_stress and outward_record_stress retain row-local adapter provenance
at least one N01 adapter-order gap survives positive stress
entropy remains a derived QIT readout only
failure_condition: If any post-stack stress row cannot preserve Omega_r -> compatibility_weights -> ordered adapters -> compression -> rho_present_stack -> outward_record_stack without dense closure or proxy substitution, write an explicit blocker instead of opening downstream consumers.
next_admissible_step: Run exactly one bounded formal scout for M_RPF_post_stack_stress, or replace this candidate with a blocker if the stress map cannot remain finite while preserving M_RPF(C) object provenance.
